style.name: Coal & Salt
style.style_block: Ragged soot-black brush contours, broken dry-brush fills and chalk-salt highlights. Strong two-value masses, rough cross-strokes only at silhouette edges; quiet broad ground. Hooded cloth silhouettes lean forward, hooked hoods, asymmetrical knotted belts and split hems. Ash umber and muted slate ground; salt ivory cloth, dull bronze hardware, restrained elemental accents. Staffs look like charred forked timber with hammered bindings. Enemies have rough slab shields and blunt black silhouettes; wardstones are chipped, tar-dark uprights. Raw confident martial drawing, never decorative papyrus. For the portrait, keep rugged ink edges beneath dense opaque oil-like face painting, dramatic light and shadow, rich dark background, chipped bronze frame.

input.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE 16:9 arena fight scene.
CAMERA FIRST: orthographic near oblique view about 55 degrees above ground, no horizon. Small upright game figures show hood tops, shoulders, a little face, foreshortened legs. Each mage HEAD TO SOLE is about SIX PERCENT of total image height (about 43 pixels in a 1280x720 image; about 65 pixels at 1080p), excluding staff, aura and shadow. Do not zoom into characters. Broad playable space occupies most of the image; open oval rim only near image edges. The arena extends beyond this view.
DIRECTION BLOCK:
Ragged soot-black brush contours, broken dry-brush fills and chalk-salt highlights. Strong two-value masses, rough cross-strokes only at silhouette edges; quiet broad ground. Hooded cloth silhouettes lean forward, hooked hoods, asymmetrical knotted belts and split hems. Ash umber and muted slate ground; salt ivory cloth, dull bronze hardware, restrained elemental accents. Staffs look like charred forked timber with hammered bindings. Enemies have rough slab shields and blunt black silhouettes; wardstones are chipped, tar-dark uprights. Raw confident martial drawing, never decorative papyrus. For the portrait, keep rugged ink edges beneath dense opaque oil-like face painting, dramatic light and shadow, rich dark background, chipped bronze frame.
FIXED COMPOSITION: four adult battle mages spaced across the lower-middle floor, at approximately (27%,60%), (43%,67%), (61%,57%), (76%,66%). Fire at left, Water Cassia next, Earth next, Air at right. Their bodies have equal screen height, each about 6%. They face diagonally up the arena in dynamic braced casting poses, never a row of frontal icons. Equipped with full wooden staffs, strapped pouches, weathered talismans, light coloured layered cloth, practical boots, hoods or cowls. Wear, patched hems, rubbed hardware; confident experienced combatants.
FIXED ELEMENTS: Fire mage pale warm cloth with ember-orange trim, sparks, embers and local heat shimmer; Cassia pale blue and ivory layers with deep blue hood, silver-blue water mist and discrete droplets; Earth mage pale ochre and ivory layers, floating stone motes and local dust; Air mage pale lilac and ivory layers, thin wind wisps and branching lightning arcs. Keep the four auras close to each figure without hiding bodies. Each has a different staff silhouette. Cassia sends a thin cyan water bolt toward the enemy shield; a short forward-facing crescent ward is separate from her body, rear open. Effects have narrow bright cores and dark edge separation, not opaque clouds.
FIXED ENEMIES: exactly three enemy types across the upper-middle floor at comparable or slightly smaller scale: two battered non-magical legion shield soldiers with helmet/shield/spear silhouettes; two low charcoal cinder hounds with angular canine bodies and small ember cracks; one broad squat thorn-backed stone creature with four legs and blunt stone plates. Active opposing combat poses; all intact, no contact injury. At least three body widths of clear floor separate every combatant; all limbs and staffs fully inside the image.
FIXED ENVIRONMENT: a weathered open oval arena of cracked sand and ash, low broken masonry at the far rim. Five distinct wardstone pylons near the perimeter, worn invented rune glyphs cut into sand, localized scorch, water residue, stone dust and wind-scoured tracks. Keep the centre quiet and navigable; atmospheric wear is clustered away from silhouettes. Mage cloth is lighter than the immediate ground, a dark lower contour and small contact shadow bind each body to that floor. Painterly volume at game scale, compressed legs, one shared light direction. Arena architecture follows the direction as strongly as the costumes.
Original designs only. Hand-drawn digital 2D concept art with visible imperfect marks, wear and material history. Raw, forceful, fantastical magic. Roman-inspired arena culture is a distant worldbuilding base, not a museum illustration. No gore, wounds, corpses, dismemberment or injury depiction. No photographic or 3D rendering, polished generic fantasy finish, clean vector contours, readable text, labels, logo or watermark. No copied characters. Invented abstract rune glyphs are allowed. Use the SAME direction language for people, equipment, creatures and architecture. This is a complete artwork, not a character sheet or multipanel grid.
